name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Enablement & Training | Onboarding, Product Adoption & CRM Platforms
summary: Customer enablement and onboarding leader with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, training customers and partners on CRM, lead-handling, and marketing automation platforms. At Birdeye, built the training sequences and onboarding program behind a 15-20 partner network that retained all but one (~94%). At Wix, onboarded 25+ clients per month and led a team of 20 onboarding specialists, including building sales training for tenured account executives. Translates product capabilities into plain-language value for owners, managers, and frontline staff at local businesses, and carries customer feedback back to Product. Denver based, near a major hub airport.
